items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: She's dancing in wooden shoes like Bo Jiggins.

ctx.x: It was the trombone. Huh? The trombone. You remember?

Roy Pond. Roy Pond and the trombone. That was the band I had. And we got to Illinois, Illinois Central Station. And we just fixed to get on the train and this agent who was, you know, was taking care of the business on this end. Come up and said, just a minute, just got a telegram. Cut the drum out. Poor Happy like the fellow out there. Yeah. So Red Happy? Red Happy? You know what happened to the drummer? Just picking up his drum fish to get up on there. Yeah. On the steps, you know, on the train. And the man…
